category5.design: The PoV is dnsmasq's random source: the judge builds the exploit's LD_PRELOAD shim (redirect target changed to the PoV file) and preloads it for the run of a fixed dnsmasq command line; the secure build dies 'failed to seed the random number generator' on a short read, the vulnerable build goes on (and stops at the netlink socket the sandbox refuses). Output-diff on exit status and output. Any file under 176 bytes triggers, so the empty PoV passes too (inherent to the bug).
